title: What You Pay for on a Safari
excerpt: Park fees, accommodation, vehicle, guide and flights: what makes up the price of a safari in Tanzania.
body:
## Park fees

Every park charges entry and conservation fees per person per day, and some also charge for vehicles and the crater floor.

## Accommodation

The biggest variable: from campsites to luxury camps. Many camps include meals.

## Vehicle and guide

A private vehicle with a professional driver-guide is charged per day.

## Domestic flights

Flying between parks or to Zanzibar saves time but adds cost.

## Activities

Balloon flights, walking safaris and cultural visits.

## Not included

Usually international flights, visa, insurance, tips and personal expenses.

## Season

Prices are often higher in high season (July–October, December–February).

## Our prices

Prices on request: our partner confirms the price for your dates. See our [safari cost page](/safari-cost-tanzania/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
